map.润滑油质量合格判定（运动粘度/水分/酸值） 使用指南: Lubricating Oil Quality Conformance Judgement (Kinematic Viscosity / Moisture / Acid Value) User Guide
map.三项判定：40℃ 运动粘度 28~32 mm²/s（牌号一致）、水分 ≤0.05: Three judgements: kinematic viscosity at 40℃ 28~32 mm²/s (grade match), moisture ≤0.05% (no free water/emulsification), acid value ≤0.1 mgKOH/g (low oxidation). All three must pass to conform; any exceedance is non-conforming.
map.按运动粘度、水分、酸值三项判定润滑油是否合格: Judge lubricant conformance on kinematic viscosity, moisture and acid value
map.输出各项是否达标与综合结论: Output whether each item passes and the overall conclusion
map.辅助设备润滑状态监测与趋势追踪: Aid equipment lubrication condition monitoring and trend tracking
map.形成可归档的合格/不合格检测报告: Produce an archivable pass/fail inspection report
map.润滑油进货与在用油验收：按运动粘度、水分、酸值三项判定合格: Acceptance of incoming lubricant and in-service oil: judged on kinematic viscosity, moisture and acid value
map.设备润滑状态监测：酸值/水分升高提示氧化或污染: Equipment lubrication condition monitoring: rising acid value/moisture indicates oxidation or contamination
map.质量归档：形成合格/不合格检测报告: Quality archiving: produce a pass/fail inspection report
map.输入运动粘度实测值并对照牌号要求: Enter the measured kinematic viscosity and compare against the grade requirement
map.点击判定，查看三项结论: Click to judge and see the three conclusions
map.对超标项安排换油或净化处理: Arrange oil change or purification for out-of-spec items
map.酸值升高反映氧化与酸性产物积累，提示油已老化或受污染，应换油: Rising acid value reflects oxidation and accumulation of acidic products, indicating the oil has aged or been contaminated and should be changed
map.水分破坏油膜、促进氧化与锈蚀，多数工业油交货要求 ≤0.05%: Moisture breaks the oil film and promotes oxidation and rust; most industrial oils specify ≤0.05% on delivery
map.运动粘度偏离牌号区间会影响油膜承载与泵送: Kinematic viscosity outside the grade range affects oil film load capacity and pumpability
map.检测结果须记录归档，便于趋势追踪与寿命管理: Test results must be recorded and archived for trend tracking and lifetime management
map.酸值升高说明什么？: What does a rising acid value mean?
map.酸值反映润滑油氧化与酸性产物积累，升高提示油已老化或受污染，润滑性能下降、易腐蚀: Acid value reflects oxidation of the lubricant and accumulation of acidic products; a rise means the oil has aged or been contaminated, lubrication performance has dropped and metal may corrode, so change the oil.
map.水分为什么要求极低？: Why is moisture required to be so low?
map.水分会破坏油膜、促进氧化与锈蚀，尤其对添加剂有水解风险；≤0.05% 是多数工业: Moisture breaks the oil film and promotes oxidation and corrosion, and poses a hydrolysis risk to additives; ≤0.05% is the delivery specification for most industrial lubricants.
